reasoning_content:
The composer.lock has locked symfony v8 packages requiring PHP >=8.4. The lock file was generated with a newer PHP. Let me check the platform config. Maybe composer.json has a platform config. Let me look.

The guide says PHP 8.2 minimum. But the lock file requires 8.4. Hmm. Let me check composer.json platform config and the lock. Maybe I can install PHP 8.4 instead. The guide says 8.2 or higher endorsed for Herd. Let me check if 8.4 available in sury. Yes.

But wait, the lock file might have been generated on a machine with newer PHP and no platform constraint. The proper fix is to use PHP >= 8.4. Let's check what the lock requires more precisely and consider installing PHP 8.4.

Actually let me check composer.json for a "config.platform.php" setting.

action.command: cd /workspace; sed -n '60,140p' composer.json; echo "---lock platform---"; grep -A20 '"platform"' composer.lock | head -40; echo "---lock content-hash php---"; php -r '$l=json_decode(file_get_contents("composer.lock"),true); echo $l["platform"]["php"]??"none","\n"; foreach($l["packages"] as $p){ if($p["name"]==="laravel/framework") echo "laravel/framework: ",$p["version"]," requires php ",$p["require"]["php"]??"?","\n"; }'

tool_call.name: terminal
tool_call.arguments: {"command": "cd /workspace; sed -n '60,140p' composer.json; echo \"---lock platform---\"; grep -A20 '\"platform\"' composer.lock | head -40; echo \"---lock content-hash php---\"; php -r '$l=json_decode(file_get_contents(\"composer.lock\"),true); echo $l[\"platform\"][\"php\"]??\"none\",\"\\n\"; foreach($l[\"packages\"] as $p){ if($p[\"name\"]===\"laravel/framework\") echo \"laravel/framework: \",$p[\"version\"],\" requires php \",$p[\"require\"][\"php\"]??\"?\",\"\\n\"; }'", "security_risk": "LOW", "summary": "Inspect composer platform requirements"}
